output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is also not safe, allowing the owner to set the total supply of the token to be arbitrarily high.
The transferFrom function allows attackers to steal funds from other users. The function does not check if the balance of the target user is sufficient, allowing attackers to exploit it.
The approve function uses a predictable random value as the allowance, allowing attackers to steal funds.
The burnFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the balance of the target user is sufficient, allowing attackers to exploit it.
